schema.purpose: Machine-readable inventory of every upstream mattpocock/skills SKILL.md at the pinned commit, plus the frozen Claude-Code/Codex -> Pi token map. Consumed by M2-M5 (porting) and M6 (scripts/validate-skills.mjs, scripts/fetch-upstream.mjs).
schema.upstreamPath: Repo-relative path of the skill directory at the pinned commit (forward slashes, no drive letters).
schema.upstreamName: Value of the upstream frontmatter `name` field. May differ from the parent directory name.
schema.bucket: engineering | productivity | misc | in-progress. Mirrors the upstream directory bucket.
schema.invocation: user | model. Derived from the presence of `disable-model-invocation: true`, read from each file (not copied from ADAPTATION_PLAN.md section 2).
schema.disableModelInvocation: Boolean mirror of the upstream frontmatter field.
schema.frontmatterFields: Every upstream frontmatter key, in file order.
schema.droppedFrontmatter: Upstream frontmatter keys Pi does not read (D2) and that must be dropped in the port.
schema.sidecars: Every file in the skill directory, including SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml, relative to the skill directory.
schema.externalLinks: http(s) URLs appearing in SKILL.md. Sidecar URLs are in sidecarExternalLinks.
schema.sidecarExternalLinks: Map of sidecar path -> http(s) URLs in that sidecar.
schema.crossSkillLoads: Operative cross-skill loads only. kind=model-load (upstream `Skill tool` or a bare /<name> operative reference) gets the D4 relative path in d4Path; kind=slash-load is a bare /<name> operative reference; kind=user-handoff is a user-invoked target, where D4 forbids a load instruction and d4Path is null.
schema.d4Path: Exact path written into the ported body, computed from the REFERENCING skill directory: same bucket `../<name>/SKILL.md`, cross-bucket `../../<bucket>/<name>/SKILL.md`. Null for kind=user-handoff and for non-ported skills.
schema.slashCommandReferences: Bare /<skill-name> references in SKILL.md (Claude slash-command syntax). Excludes /clear and /compact, which are harnessTokens. Resolves to D5-16.
schema.harnessTokens: Canonical token labels found in SKILL.md. Every label resolves to a row in tokenMap via tokenMap.tokenIndex.
schema.sidecarHarnessTokens: Map of sidecar path -> canonical token labels found in that sidecar.
schema.hasOpenaiYaml: True when the skill ships an agents/openai.yaml sidecar (all 38 at the pin).
schema.disposition: port | adapt | rename | drop | defer, consistent with ADAPTATION_PLAN.md section 2.
schema.ownerMilestone: M2 | M3 | M4 | M5 | post-v1 | none.
schema.piPath: Path in THIS package once shipped, or null when not shipped. Renamed skills use the renamed directory.
schema.confidence: verified | inferred. verified means read directly from the pinned file; inferred means derived from plan policy rather than the file.
schema.notes: Free text. Empty string means nothing beyond the structured fields.
